en:
I'll crush these bastards for
targeting defenseless women.
I can't let these guys run rampant in Kamurocho.

How rotten do you have to be to feed off
other people's happiness?

Someone's sick... I should be able to
help them if I have some medicine.

If this arsonist likes to set fires so much,
I'll give him the heat he deserves.

I heard something is going down at
the Oyster Shack. Let's see if it's true...
I should see if he'll eat anything.

Never thought I'd see Jo Amon again... Either way,
I should take a taxi over to the floating island once
I've made all the necessary preparations.

I guess fighting him is the only way out.
This won't be easy, so I have to give it my all!
I'm supposed to meet Riona over on Pink Street.

This guy tried to assault Riona.
Let's see how he likes it.
I promised to meet Sora in Theater Square...

It's time for my meeting with Saki.
I should hurry over to the Millennium Tower.

I can't stand cowards who pick on the weak.
Saki's fan is more courageous than these punks.

(Chapter 3)
Apparently this Ino guy has an apartment for me
down by the coast. I should head over there.

(Chapter 3)
It's only fair that I return the favor.
Time to meet Kiyomi at the ropeway station.

(Chapter 2)
Akiyama's apparently over at Touto Hospital.
I should take a taxi to go see him.

(Chapter 5)
It's just about time for my meeting with Kiyomi.
She should be waiting at the top of the ropeway.

(Chapter 6)
Those two should be able to handle themselves just fine.
I should hurry over to Stardust and meet Joon-gi Han.

Gori-san agreed to join my baseball team
if I can beat him in a home run competition.
I need to win this!
I need to hit 7 or more home runs to beat Gori-san!

(Chapter 1)
These punks should be a good refresher course.

(Chapter 11)
Yuta's not back yet... Is he still on the phone?

(Chapter 11)
Where could Yuta have gone?
Did he really go to Little Asia all by himself...?

(Chapter 12)
It sounded like Lo wants to talk to me in private.
I should head up to the roof.

(Chapter 12)
Nagumo and the others should be waiting
for me over at the Hirose Family Office.

(Chapter 12)
J7B7R36N1M7E9O22I1K1
In total, there are nine pairs of letters and numbers.
The substitution table has something to do with Onomichi...

(Chapter 12)
Naval soldier Yamano Dodai's grave...
The truth behind the secret must be hidden there.

(Chapter 12)
Ino's waiting for me with his boat.
I should hurry down to the dock.

(Finale)
Someya's apparently waiting for me down at the dock.

(Finale)
If Someya's telling the truth, the Hirose Family
is in trouble. I need to tell them!

(Finale)
This is probably going to be my last day in Onomichi.
I should head to the Navy Apartments when I'm ready...

(Finale)
There's so much I want to say to Haruka.
I should take a taxi to the police hospital to see her.

(Finale)
It's time to storm the Millennium Tower and take Sugai down.
I should make sure I'm not forgetting anything first.

(Finale)
It seems like Nagumo has something to say to me.
I should head up to the roof.

It's time for our game against the Jingai Thunders
reserve squad. Chiba's waiting for me up at the
baseball field.

Let's win a game against the Jingai Thunders reserve squad.
There has to be something to gain from a first victory.

Losing to a reserve squad is a little embarrassing...
We should strengthen the team and try again.

We beat the Jingai Thunders reserve squad!
It feels like we're really coming together as a team.
We managed to win our first game!

(Chapter 1)
I should ask at New Serena and Bantam
for any information they might have.

It's time for our game against the Onomichi Legends.
Chiba's waiting for me up at the baseball field.
I should talk to Chiba when I'm ready for the game.

These Onomichi Legends really are legendary...
We should train hard for our next game against them.
The Warriors are really starting to gel.

Chiba said he'd be waiting for me at the baseball field.
I guess it's my duty as the team captain to show up.

A potential teammate named Moritsuka is apparently
at a bar somewhere in town. I should go take a look
down in the bar district.

Moritsuka's in terrible shape... but I guess
it wouldn't hurt to talk to him.
This guy's hopeless. I should sober him up a bit.

It's time for our game against the Jingai Thunders.
I should go see Chiba up at the baseball field.

Jingai Thunders, here we come. I should talk
to Chiba when I'm ready to play.

It's no surprise that their main team is a challenge...
but we won't lose again. We should strengthen
the team so we're ready for next time.
This win is a testament to our team unity.

Some guy at Bantam challenged me to a round
of darts. I should go play him if I have the time.

I don't know if I'm really that good at darts, but I'll
keep trying to play against people if I have time.

Yoshida asked me to try his trial course.
I guess I'll give it a shot...

Yoshida says he'll do anything I want if I can hit
five home runs in a row. Let's see if he means it.

Looks like I'll be helping the Setouchi Warriors now.
I should get a taxi to the field when I have some time.

There's a slasher on the loose. I can't let
anyone else fall victim to his crimes.
I need to get rid of this drunkard somehow.

Apparently people are worried about
the graffiti on the wall. I should find the culprit.

I should do something about the
problematic railway enthusiast.
I should go catch some fish.

Apparently someone's robbing graves.
The dead can't defend themselves, so I will.

Sounds like someone's child has gone missing.
I should do what I can to help out.

I need to put that fire out.
If only I had a fire extinguisher...

That Haruka fan looks depressed for some reason.
I should see if I can find out why.

I promised Ayaka I'd get her some Haruka
merchandise. I should try to find something
at Don Quijote.

Idol fans apparently show up at Club SEGA in
Theater Square all the time. I should go talk to them.

One particularly eager fan told me
Ebisu Pawn sells a rare picture
of Haruka. I need to get that photo!

A Haruka fan is getting mugged by a gang of thugs.
They've messed with the wrong fanbase.

I managed to get my hands on the picture of Haruka.
I should bring it back to Ayaka.
I'm glad Ayaka liked the photo.

Some little round thing just whirred by me...
Let me talk to the guy on Suppon Street about it.

The guy said his cleaning robot is running loose around
the city. Maybe I should help him if I have time.

Fujita asked me to catch his rampant cleaning robot.
I'm going to have to chase it down the streets, aren't I?
I detect dirt too, Soji. Time to get rid of them.

Some guy told me about an AI app called Hiji...
I should talk to him again if I'm interested.

I'm not so comfortable talking to Hiji in public.
I should try it out by myself at the Children's Park.

Hiji's telling me to leave the park.
I guess I'll do what it says for now...

What a mess Hiji's gone and dragged me into.
No choice but to take care of this drunkard now.

If I want to get rid of Hiji, I'll have to go back and talk
to that sales rep over on Nakamichi Street.

What the heck does that guy want with my phone?
I'll have to catch him and make him fess up.

I met a man named Tsutsui who makes videos
for a living. Hopefully he's managing to stay
out of trouble...

I can't believe the trouble he's causing
all for the sake of his video. What a mess.

Tsutsui isn't interested in my advice.
He still has a lot to learn about the world.

Tsutsui's hanging out the window of Lullaby Mahjong.
He deserves it... but I guess I should still help him.

If words won't convince this idiot to give it up,
he's going to find my fists aren't so social.

Apparently there's a "drone" flying around Kamurocho.
I wonder what that even means...
I should go find out what that scream was about.

Apparently drones attack people sometimes.
I guess I need to be careful, too.

I can't let this drone keep putting people in danger.
I should follow it and figure out where it's going.

What kind of yakuza force a kid to film Kamurocho?
I'll have to punish them for this.

What kind of madman would set off a bomb?
I should go take a look in the area.

Is the Saio Triad behind all this? Either way, there's
apparently a suspicious guy over at the batting center.

I don't know who this guy is or where he's from...
but it's time to make him fess up.
This guy just doesn't know when to quit!

Letting that guy die just wouldn't seem right.
I should head back to the Yoshida Batting Center...

They must be bored if they're here just for revenge.
Glad to see I won't have to hold back, though.

That should keep them calm for a while.
I still can't believe they set that bomb...

Dammit, the girl already changed locations.
Where could she have gone?

This girl might be indecisive, but damn is she
beautiful. Maybe she's on a roof somewhere...?

Those guys came up with a pretty terrible plan...
and they picked the worst possible person to trick.
I knew this sounded too good to be true.

Date-san asked me to get 50,000 yen in prepaid cards.
I should be able to find them at a convenience store.

Apparently I have to go to the roof of
the Senryo Building. Date-san's waiting
for me. Or maybe...

Turns out it was a scam.
I'll make this guy pay for trying to trick me.

Hikaru's gotten herself mixed up with some
shady people. I'm worried about her.

That suspicious guy took Hikaru inside.
I have a bad feeling about this...
Time to take these guys down and save Hikaru!
So this guy is Erina's stalker. I need to protect her!

Hm, this live chat thing does seem interesting.
I should meet up with that guy at the internet café
over by Theater Square.

Some guy who claims to know Saejima challenged me
to a fight. He doesn't know what he's getting himself into.

That guy who says he knows Saejima challenged me
to another fight. I'll give this my all!

I can't believe these guys tried to mug me.
Looks like I'll have to teach them a little lesson.

I'm not sure who these JUSTIS people are,
but I won't lay down and let them win.

Sachiko's been taken by those JUSTIS guys.
Joe and I need to save her soon.

So this is one of the Six Lunatics, Toru Yano.
All right... Let's see what this weirdo's got.

Another one of the Six Lunatics, Naito...
If he wants a fight, I'll give him a fight.

Time to find out if 1 + 1 is really 200.
Let's do this, Joe!

It's hard trading blows with a friend, but sometimes it's the only
way to understand where they're coming from. Don't give up, Joe!

Kazuchika Okada, the leader of JUSTIS...
He's strong, but not strong enough to stop me!

So the puppet master finally showed himself...
Joe! Okada! Let's take him down together!

It sounded like that old guy is in some real trouble.
Maybe I should do him a favor if I have time.

Apparently I need to get the name order right if I want
to get into their HQ. I think it was Munan... something.

After all that talk about virtue, they resort to violence.
I need to take these guys down and go see the guru.

The guru's true nature is finally clear. I'll just have to
chomo gomes him so he can never do wrong again.

It's been ages since I last saw Pocket Circuit Fighter.
He looks a lot older... Though I guess I do, too.

I promised Pocket Circuit Fighter's son Sakito
that I'd teach him all about Pocket Circuit racing.
I should stop by La Pente sometime.

Sakito ran off, apparently to somewhere you can
see the ocean from. I need to find him soon!
Let's protect Sakito together, Pocket Circuit Fighter.
Who is this guy...? I guess I can ask questions later.

I'm not sure I can just decide to believe in ghosts...
but maybe I should come back to the cemetery at
night sometime, just in case.

I didn't expect another ghost to show up behind me.
I've got to hand it to 'em<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>that was a real surprise.

I'm not too keen on this ghost taking a shine to me.
I should stop by the cemetery at night sometime.

I've already come this far... If fighting these guys puts
their souls at rest, I won't let them down!

I'm worried about the old man... I should stop by
the cemetery at night after some time has passed.

They must really like me to come three at a time.
At least they're all enjoying themselves.

The old man said the next fight will be the last one.
I'll give these ghosts the fight of their afterlives.
